comparison.objective: Transfer one measured volume with an air-displacement pipette versus commission a damper.
comparison.physical_skill: Tip handling, plunger staging, aspiration, transfer, and dispense versus mechanical unlocking, fine rotation, relocking, and impact-response adjustment.
comparison.success_condition: One volume must be transferred; accuracy, contamination, and spill thresholds are missing. Candidate requires two quantitatively safe locked stops.
comparison.reason: Liquid metering and transfer are materially different from rigid mechanical calibration.
